€1P. (ग्लायति, ग्लान) 
__1 To feel aversion or dislike, be unwilling or disinclined to do anything (with inf.). 
__2 To be fatigued or wearied, feel tired or exhausted. 
__3 To despond, sink in spirit, be dejected; नाऽवकल्प्यमिदं ग्लायेद् यत् कृच्छ्रेषु भबानपि [[

.]] 
__2 To tire out, exhaust. 
__3 To injure, trouble, hurt. 
__4 To emaciate, waste; व्रतैः स्वमङ्गं ग्लपयन्त्यहर्निशम् [[
